**Data Call Generalization and Collection**

```{r}
fetch_team_season <- function(team, season){
  url <- paste0("https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/club-schedule-season/", team, "/", season)
  resp <- request(url) |>
    req_throttle(rate = 5) |>
    req_perform()
  resp_body_json(resp)$games
}

#test <- fetch_team_season("BUF", "20232024")
#length(test)   # 89, same as before

teams <- c("ANA","ARI","BOS","BUF","CGY","CAR","CHI","COL","CBJ","DAL",
           "DET","EDM","FLA","LAK","MIN","MTL","NSH","NJD","NYI","NYR",
           "OTT","PHI","PIT","SJS","SEA","STL","TBL","TOR","VAN","VGK",
           "WSH","WPG")

seasons <- c("20212022", "20222023", "20232024")

pairs <- expand.grid(team = teams, season = seasons,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#nrow(pairs)   # 96
#head(pairs)

raw <- map2(pairs$team, pairs$season, fetch_team_season, .progress = TRUE)
length(raw)   # 96

all_games <- list_flatten(raw)
length(all_games)   # ~8500-ish (96 team-seasons × ~89 games each)

```

**Data Received Check But With A Function**

```{r}
game_to_row <- function(g) {
  tibble(
    game_id     = g$id,
    season      = g$season,
    game_type   = g$gameType,
    game_date   = as.Date(g$gameDate),
    home_team   = g$homeTeam$abbrev,
    home_score  = g$homeTeam$score,
    away_team   = g$awayTeam$abbrev,
    away_score  = g$awayTeam$score,
    last_period = g$gameOutcome$lastPeriodType
  )
}
```

```{r}
game_to_row(all_games[[1]])

games_raw <- map(all_games, game_to_row) |> list_rbind()
nrow(games_raw)
```

**Data Wrangling**

```{r}
games_clean <- games_raw |>
  filter(game_type == 2) |>
  distinct(game_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-game_type)

nrow(games_clean)   # should be 3936 (1312 per season × 3 seasons)
```

**Save and Push**

```{r}
write_csv(games_clean, "data/games_raw.csv")
```

Safety Checks

```{r}
games_clean |> count(season)                # 1312 per season
games_clean |> count(last_period)           # REG largest, OT and SO smaller
range(games_clean$game_date)                # earliest 2021-10-xx, latest 2024-04-xx
games_clean |> filter(home_score == away_score) |> nrow()   # 0 — NHL has no ties
```
